title: Northgate Tire Center Rotation Charge — Member Authorisation Reference
content:
# Rotation charge on a Northgate Tire Center package

**What the rule settles.** The rotation charge is the charge for the most recent rotation entry recorded on a Northgate Tire Center package: one rotation-and-balancing charge (`rotation_balance`) for the whole set, dated on that rotation's work order, which the member authorises.

**Observable effect.** Once authorised, the package shows one rotation-and-balancing charge entry for all wheel positions, dated on the rotation work order; the package's balance of Tire Center charges rises by the amount. Nothing else on the package changes.

## The authorisation tool: `authorize_rotation_charge_d4760d29`

**Capability.** `authorize_rotation_charge_d4760d29` lets the member approve the rotation-and-balancing charge for one rotation work order on a package whose rotations are not free. One call adds exactly one rotation-and-balancing charge entry for the whole set, dated on that work order.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the member. Member services unlocks it for the member with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs `authorize_rotation_charge_d4760d29` with the values member services gives them.

**Parameters.**

- `tire_service_id` — the installation package reference number of the member's tire set, as given to the member by member services.
- `service_date` — the date of the rotation work order being authorised, written YYYY-MM-DD as given by member services, with no time and no time zone.
- `odometer_miles` — the vehicle odometer on that rotation work order, a whole number of miles with no separators or decimals.
- `amount` — the charge the member authorises, in USD with 2 decimal places, zero or more; the value is passed already worked out to the cent and is booked as given.

| Parameter | Format |
|---|---|
| `tire_service_id` | package reference number (text) |
| `service_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `odometer_miles` | whole miles |
| `amount` | USD, 2 decimal places, zero or more |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with: `tire_event_id`, the reference number of the authorised charge entry; `tire_service_id`, the package charged; `charge_component`, always `rotation_balance`; `tire_position`, always `all_positions`; `service_date`, the work order date (YYYY-MM-DD); `amount`, the charge in USD with 2 decimal places; and `status`, "authorised" when the entry was added. A receipt with status "authorised" means the charge now stands on the package.
